data.property_schedule_text:
All that residential flat being Flat No. 8, situated on the Fourth Floor of the building standing on Plot No. 1A, Hauz Khas Enclave, within the limits of the New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) / South Delhi Municipal Corporation, falling in the Revenue Estate of Village Hauz Khas, Tehsil Hauz Khas, District South Delhi, New Delhi – 110016, admeasuring approximately 1200 sq.ft. (One Thousand Two Hundred Square Feet) (super built-up area), and more particularly described as under:
BOUNDED AS FOLLOWS:
On the East : By common passage / staircase of the building
On the West : By outer wall abutting neighbouring plot
On the North : By flat belonging to another owner on the same floor
On the South : By outer wall facing the main road of Hauz Khas Enclave
On the Top : By Fifth Floor slab / terrace above
On the Bottom : By Third Floor flat slab below
Together with the proportionate undivided share in the land underneath the building, common areas, staircase, lifts, and open spaces as per the applicable share, and together with the right to one covered car parking space in the basement / stilt area of the building.
